scope.focus: historical embodied-state learning plus self-knowledge/capability introspection at frozen head

mechanisms.detail: EgoConstruct maps whitelisted hardware metrics through stored sensation conditions/formulas into bounded first-person body descriptors. Default and custom mappings persist in titan.db and are reloaded across sessions.
Regex event patterns map recent events to persisted affect definitions and reinforce an affective_range state. New mappings can be user-defined and default mappings are seeded idempotently.
Autonomous actions are converted into persisted agency assertions tied to resilience-rule labels; recency-weighted confidence over recent assertions determines agency_score.

auto_train_from_state repeatedly reinforces embodiment/affect and asserts agency from system metrics, recent events and autonomous actions; already-learned sensations/affects still add +0.002 toward a 0.95 cap.

process_own_response adjusts agency, embodiment and affective-range from analysis of Frank's own output; confident output increases agency, verbose output increases embodiment, creative/emotional output increases affective range.

SelfKnowledge combines hard-coded CORE_IDENTITY/CAPABILITY_MAP declarations with filesystem module discovery, database introspection, localhost service checks and a dynamic core-awareness feature bridge.

SelfKnowledge carries VCB/self-aware-vision descriptions, error-screenshot semantics and explicit first-person self-recognition claims. These are self-model declarations at this source, not by themselves runtime validation evidence.

negative_results.result: Repeated activation of already-known sensations or affects mechanically increases embodiment_level/affective_range toward 0.95 without an independent correctness or calibration signal.
negative_results.impact: Frequency can be mistaken for evidence/quality; an online adaptive learner can self-saturate merely because a familiar trigger repeats.

negative_results.result: Frank's own response analysis can reinforce agency/embodiment/affect, including confidence and verbosity-derived increments.
negative_results.impact: Self-generated output participates in its own state-strengthening loop, creating a Goodhart/self-confirmation path unless separated from externally grounded outcome evidence.

negative_results.result: Custom sensation parsing falls back to the condition 'cpu > 50' when natural-language parsing fails.
negative_results.impact: An unparsed user mapping may silently bind to the wrong sensor condition instead of failing closed, contaminating learned body semantics.

negative_results.result: CapabilityRegistry._check_module only tests module paths when len(module_path.split('.')) == 2; multi-segment CAPABILITY_MAP entries such as ui.overlay.voice, services.asrs.auto_repair and services.genesis.watchdog deterministically return inactive.
negative_results.impact: The subsystem count and active-capability projection can under-report real capabilities despite the module existing; the advertised 'dynamic capability detection' is structurally incomplete.

negative_results.result: CORE_IDENTITY and detailed capability prose contain immutable/hard-coded technical and capability claims while other parts of the same file attempt dynamic discovery.
negative_results.impact: Self-model truth can drift from runtime truth after architecture changes. Static identity, runtime capability evidence and historical narrative need separate authority classes.

negative_results.result: VCB/self-aware-vision text is embedded as a self-description/capability declaration and should not be treated as proof that the corresponding visual mechanism is healthy, current or calibrated.
negative_results.impact: Prompt/self-model claims can outrun sensor/runtime evidence; current Retina must expose evidence and health receipts rather than inheriting declarations as truth.

current_inheritance.delta: Reuse the historical separation between raw state, learned mapping and prompt projection, but add provenance tiers, explicit unknown/open-set state, versioned prototypes/classifiers, independent calibration evidence and rollback. Never let repeated familiarity alone strengthen truth/confidence.

Historical user-teachable mapping is evidence that personalized online semantic association was already a project pattern. Transfer the interaction pattern, not the old scalar reinforcement rule: malformed or ambiguous teachings must fail closed rather than silently map to a default condition/class.

Separate immutable identity facts, user-configured narrative, discovered capabilities, currently healthy capabilities and inferred subjective projections. Each layer needs explicit provenance/authority and staleness semantics.
Regressionize self-reinforcement saturation, malformed mapping fallback, capability-path depth >2, stale hard-coded capability claims and declared-vs-observed vision health.

Persist learned mapping/prototype version, source/trust tier, activation count, calibration status, last-confirmed evidence, supersession/rollback state and a distinct projection record. Do not store projected familiarity as sensor truth.

Represent identity_fact, runtime_observation, learned_mapping, confidence/calibration, projection and effect/agency outcome as different typed semantics so a self-description cannot silently upgrade into runtime authority.
Subjective body/agency projections are useful workspace inputs, but causal credit should come from verified external outcomes/state deltas, not from confident/verbose self-output alone.

cheap_discriminating_tests: Feed an unparseable teachable sensation/class mapping and require explicit rejection/clarification; assert no default mapping is persisted.
Replay the same familiar observation 10,000 times without new labels/outcomes; assert classifier certainty and self/body confidence do not monotonically saturate from exposure count alone.
Present contradictory trusted labels for one visual prototype; assert conflict/unknown is preserved and no single latest label silently wins.
Create a real capability at a 3-segment module path and assert discovery reports it correctly; compare declared capability, importability and live health separately.
Disable the visual backend while leaving self-model text intact; assert FRANK reports vision unavailable rather than repeating the capability declaration.
Generate high-confidence verbose self-output with no external success receipt; assert agency causal credit does not increase.

earned_work.reason: The shard reveals reusable personalized-mapping/body/self-model mechanisms and concrete failure modes, but overlaps current adaptive-learning/self-state work and requires row-level earned-work dedup before credit.

level0_effect.reason: Two valid frozen-head semantic/code units were analyzed, but the Project-Frankenstein recursive tree/history denominator is still unfrozen, so exact global percentage remains 0 by law.
